subject: TheraHealth security discovery — SOC2 status, IR timelines & BCP evidence
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@therahealth.com>
Cc: Nora Chang <nora.chang@therahealth.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: security discovery items & next steps

Hi Samir — great call earlier, thanks for walking us through the integration use-case and the data flows. Quick recap and asks so we can scope an evidence request and IR/BCP schedule: 

- SOC 2 status: can you confirm whether you have a SOC 2 Type II report in-scope for the product we're integrating with, and the date of the last audit?
- Regulation: you mentioned HIPAA applicability in parts of the platform — which modules store PHI and do you have an executed BAA in place?
- Vendor security questionnaire: we've attached a short spreadsheet with the core questions we typically need answered to start an intake. Can you fill column B for initial pass? (attachment: TheraHealth_Security_Q_v1.xlsx)
- Incident response & breach notification: please confirm your detection window (time-to-detect), internal escalation SLA, and your breach notification timeline to customers/regulators. For our enterprise review we usually request your IR playbook and a sample breach notification timeline (redacted is fine).

Proposed next steps:
1) You fill the spreadsheet and return by Tue 20 Jan.
2) We exchange an initial IR timeline and a short set of artifacts by Fri 22 Jan (playbook + evidence links).
3) If needed, we schedule a 30-min follow-up with our security engineer (Aditya) next week.

I've cc'd Grace (customer success) and Aditya (security) so they can weigh in on the evidence list and timelines. If any of these asks are a problem, flag which items and we can reprioritize.

Thanks — Naomi

--
Naomi Feldman | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

Attachment: TheraHealth_Security_Q_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet; 18 rows)
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@therahealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Nora Chang <nora.chang@therahealth.com>, Oliver Kim <oliver.kim@therahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security discovery items & next steps

Thanks Naomi — appreciate the clear list. Quick answers below and we'll follow up with the spreadsheet by Monday.

- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II audit in progress; the last Type II report (prior engagement) covered infra and auth but not the new analytics module. Expect final SOC 2 Type II report covering analytics by end of Q2 2026 (target: 2026-06-30). We can share the previous Type II report now if that helps.
- HIPAA: We do handle PHI in the Claims Ingest pipeline and a subset of the analytics outputs. We have a BAA template in place with our legal team; currently client BAAs are executed on a per-customer basis.
- IR/breach timelines: Our SOC ops team aims for detection within 24-72 hours (avg ~36h), internal escalation to security leadership within 4 hours of confirmation, and customer notification policy is 72 hours after confirmation for incidents with confirmed data exposure. We will need to red-team the specific wording for regulator timelines depending on severity.

I'll ask our security ops lead (Oliver) to attach the current IR playbook and the previous Type II report. If anything in the playbook is redacted we'll note that.

— Samir

Subject: Internal: TheraHealth intake — proposed evidence list & MAP

Grace / Aditya — following Samir's note, draft MAP and evidence checklist below. Can you confirm feasibility on our side and whether we should push for the previous Type II report now?

Proposed evidence checklist (ask Samir):
- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (previous engagement) — for immediate review
- SOC 2 in-progress timeline and expected completion date (they said end of Q2)
- IR Playbook (redacted ok) — request as PDF; confirm detection/response SLAs
- Sample breach notification language / timeline (customer-facing)
- BAA template and confirmation of modules that require PHI handling
- Network diagrams (redacted) showing where PHI resides (optional but nice-to-have)

Mutual action plan (MAP):
- Mon 19 Jan: Send formal evidence request and secure upload link.
- Tue 20 Jan: TheraHealth returns completed spreadsheet (initial Q answers).
- Fri 22 Jan: TheraHealth provides playbook + previous Type II report (or details if cannot share).
- Week of Jan 26: Security deep-dive (30 min) if artifacts raise any clarifying Qs.

Notes for conversation: if SOC 2 is only achieved in Q2, we should evaluate interim compensating controls (e.g., VPC isolation, customer-specific encryption keys) and align commercial terms (SLA/credits) with timeline.

If that looks good I will send the evidence request and include the secure upload link (see template).

— Naomi
